visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black t-shirt, sits cross-legged on a wooden floor in a home setting. He is holding open a large brown bag filled with colorful folded clothing. In the background, a wooden dining table and a kitchen counter with appliances are visible under bright indoor lighting. (2) The man demonstrates the bag's rectangular shape and its large opening. He turns the bag around to show straps and hanging loops on the back side. He then proceeds to pull a long zipper across the top edge of the bag. (3) The man finishes zipping the bag closed and points to two circular grey valves on the front. He leans his body weight onto the bag, pressing down firmly with both hands to push air out through the valves. (4) As he presses, the bag visibly flattens and becomes more compact. He closes the two valves and then lifts the now-compressed bag to show its reduced thickness to the camera from multiple angles while still sitting on the floor.
